usage: The standard apology in Modern Standard Arabic. The adjective agrees with the speaker, not the listener, so a woman says asifatun. It covers everything from being late to a real mistake; for a formal or written apology, a3tadhiru is the better choice.

variants.label: said by a woman
variants.note: The form a woman uses about herself.

variants.label: stronger
variants.note: Use when the mistake actually cost the other person something.

variants.label: formal
variants.note: Use in writing, at work, or in an official apology.

variants.label: asking forgiveness, to a man
variants.note: Use with someone close when you have hurt them.

examples.english: I'm sorry, I did not mean that.

examples.arabic: أَنَا آسِفٌ، لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ الْحُضُورَ غَداً.
examples.transliteration: ana asifun, la astati3u al-7udura ghadan.
examples.english: I'm sorry, I cannot come tomorrow.
